procedure: Define labels and handling rules from the approved classification scheme; apply them to relevant files, records and exchanges, including exceptions and automated propagation. Train users and investigate missing or incorrect labels.
test_procedure: Select information from actual repositories and transfers; compare labels and handling with approved classification, including transformed/exported copies and authorized exceptions.

procedure: Reconcile assigned devices, media, credentials and information on exit or transfer; obtain custody records, revoke access, recover assets and escalate unresolved returns with risk treatment.
test_procedure: Trace exit/transfer events to the independent asset and access inventories; inspect missing returns and evidence that continuing access and retained copies were addressed.

procedure: Inventory sensitive power and network cable routes, exposed access points and provider responsibilities; protect routes from interception, damage and interference and inspect after relevant site changes.
test_procedure: Inspect selected actual routes and access points against the risk-based design; trace defects and third-party responsibilities to remediation records.

procedure: Schedule equipment maintenance against service and supplier requirements; authorize personnel and access, protect information during repair and verify equipment integrity before return to service.
test_procedure: Reconcile maintained assets to due work; inspect technician authorization, information protection and return-to-service checks, including off-site repair.

procedure: Define approved time sources and permissible divergence for relevant systems; configure synchronization, monitor deviations and preserve event timestamps and correction history.
test_procedure: Compare selected system clocks and log timestamps with approved sources; exercise an approved divergence alert and verify response without rewriting historical events.

procedure: Identify uses that need obscured data; define masking from purpose, permissions and reidentification risk, restrict access to originals and validate transformed outputs before use.
test_procedure: Trace selected nonproduction/analytical uses to purpose-specific rules; test residual identifiability, access to originals and leakage through logs or exports.

procedure: Identify sensitive information and relevant egress paths; implement risk-based prevention/detection, triage events and govern exceptions. Reconcile covered channels and validate rules after material changes.
test_procedure: Use approved synthetic sensitive data to test relevant egress paths; inspect detection/blocking, triage and authorized exceptions, including channels not covered by tooling.

procedure: Determine web-access risks and applicable user/system populations; configure protective access rules, updates, exception approval and response to malicious or prohibited access.
test_procedure: Reconcile populations to applied rules; use safe approved test destinations to verify enforcement and examine exception expiry and alert handling.

procedure: Approve information used in development and testing for its purpose; minimize sensitive content, protect test copies and access, record transfers and securely remove copies when no longer needed.
test_procedure: Trace test datasets to origin, approvals and protection; inspect access and deletion records and verify production data was not copied without authorization.

procedure: Agree test scope, access, timing and safeguards before assessment of operating systems; protect credentials and information, monitor disruptive effects and define stop and restoration steps.
test_procedure: Inspect selected assessment activities for prior scope and safeguards; reconcile access and extracted records to cleanup, and verify stop/restoration arrangements.

procedure: Define security requirements and review rights for externally developed systems; monitor supplier delivery, inspect design and test evidence, control changes and validate acceptance against the exact delivered version.
test_procedure: Trace selected supplier releases to agreed requirements, review evidence, unresolved defects and authorized acceptance; investigate version or responsibility gaps.
